title: -ir verbs — regular

type: fill
prompt: Je ___ (finir) le devoir.
verb: finir
answer: finis
why: je: drop -ir, add -is.
---
type: mcq
prompt: Tu ___ (finir) le devoir.
verb: finir
choices: finis | finissons | finissez | finissent
answer: finis
why: tu: drop -ir, add -is.
